sections.heading: The long pickup is the buying case.
paragraphs: The green V2 Gladiator is an appealing first micro crawler when scale pickup detail and a longer chassis are the point of the purchase. Its current published wheelbase is 155mm, compared with the 4Runner's 132mm. That difference is large enough to matter when planning the obstacle course and ordering links or driveshafts. It is not evidence that one is universally more stable. I would choose the Jeep for the overlanding pickup presentation and a course that lets its longer proportions make sense.

The exact purchase in this guide is Axial SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2 AXI00005V2T3, Green · Spektrum V2 complete crawler. Its 1/24 scale, 4WD drivetrain and brushed power system identify a complete assembled vehicle. That combination should be matched to first-time long-wheelbase micro scale crawler buyer before a promotional feature becomes the reason to order. Decide where the car will be driven most often, because a usable nearby space can be more valuable than a longer feature list. The dated manufacturer documentation supplies the hardware facts, the Amazon API supplies listing identity, and outside coverage remains the work of its named author. Our preference is an editorial interpretation of those sources. It does not turn the published claims into personal driving experience or measured results.

sections.heading: V2 means Spektrum equipment and oil-filled shocks.
paragraphs: This exact AXI00005V2T3 includes a Spektrum SLT2 radio, 350mAh 2S LiPo, USB-C charger and four AA cells. The revised oil-filled shocks are also part of the current official description. Earlier Gladiator packages used a different control arrangement, so an old four-channel radio description is not the current inventory. Inspect the box against the V2 list and keep the manual revision with the truck. An attractive used Gladiator can be a different electronics generation even if the body is familiar.

For SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2, the stated drive-power arrangement is Spektrum 350mAh 2S LiPo · included, and the radio package is Spektrum SLT2; 2-in-1 ESC/receiver. Required completion is explicit: Nothing required per official package. Make a physical inventory before buying additional equipment. The finished vehicle already coordinates the body, drivetrain and installed controls, but correct operation still requires the model's startup and charging procedure. Check the pack leads and connectors without pulling on their wires, inspect steering travel before running, and confirm the transmitter power arrangement against the actual holder. If an item differs from the exact AXI00005V2T3 list, resolve that with the seller or manufacturer while the purchase details are available. A package discrepancy should not be covered up by ordering a replacement and assuming every similarly named RTR comes with the same components.

sections.heading: Worm axles support a slow-crawling purchase.
paragraphs: The 030 brushed motor drives front and rear worm-gear axles through the compact SCX24 transmission. Worm reduction contributes to low gearing and descent behavior, but it does not make the vehicle immune to getting stuck or slipping sideways. When the tires are wedged against an obstacle, release the load and choose another line rather than holding the trigger indefinitely. The factory drive arrangement makes sense for technical micro crawling, while it gives little reason to buy this Jeep for covering a long trail at walking speed.

The documented 030-size brushed motor is the power equipment evaluated for SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2. For a crawling vehicle, reduction, tire support and controllable application of power matter more to the buying case than a maximum-speed headline. A trapped tire also loads the drivetrain, so choose another approach rather than applying prolonged power against a stall. Start from the original AXI00005V2T3 gearing and battery specification. Keep optional electronics purchases separate until the stock configuration reveals a specific requirement worth changing.

sections.heading: The current radio should be judged on its own terms.
paragraphs: SLT2 proportional controls and reduced throttle settings form the current beginner control package. The historical Small-Scale RC review praised the original Gladiator's radio and low-speed response, but those observations belong to the earlier equipment and are not transferred to this V2. Use the official manual for binding and controller setup. Test the steering direction and neutral throttle with the truck in a clear area, then practice placing one front tire on an obstacle edge without applying a large trigger movement.

The SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2 control system is listed as Spektrum SLT2; 2-in-1 ESC/receiver. Treat the manual as the reference for binding, reversing, neutral settings and any assistance function supplied with this exact package. Radio frequency alone does not establish compatibility with a replacement transmitter or receiver. Check steering trim on the surface you intend to use, then verify response in both directions before a demanding session. For shared casual use, explain how to stop and shut down the vehicle before handing the controls to another driver. If the car behaves incorrectly, distinguish a setting issue from physical binding. A new electronic part is a poor first response when the existing linkage is prevented from moving freely.

sections.heading: Long wheelbase requires matching parts, not a generic SCX24 order.
paragraphs: A three-link front and four-link rear suspension support the Jeep's solid axles, with oil damping in the current version. The long chassis changes the relevant link and driveshaft combinations. Parts labeled SCX24 can be intended for a different wheelbase, which is why the Gladiator drawing matters. The current product table uses a rounded 155mm wheelbase while parts descriptions use 153.7mm. We preserve that difference and do not present it as a home measurement or a reason to force a mismatched part into position.

The published construction for SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2 is steel c-channel rails; oil-filled shocks; solid axles. Those details describe what an owner can inspect and maintain; they do not provide a measured suspension or steering score. Use the original mounting positions as a reference and check movement before changing springs, shock positions or link lengths. Its listed wheelbase is 155 mm in current product table, which makes exact replacement compatibility more useful than a generic Axial parts search. Confirm tire clearance through steering travel and suspension movement with the body installed. Change one mechanical setting at a time, record the new position and return to the baseline if the result becomes confusing. A good tuning process should explain the change you are seeking, rather than replace several components at once and leave you unable to identify which one helped.

sections.heading: Give the middle of the truck room to clear the crest.
paragraphs: The Nitto Trail Grappler M/T tires and KMC Machete wheels give the stock Jeep its scale identity. The longer axle spacing can be helpful for some obstacle shapes and awkward when the center bridges a sharp crest. That is a geometry consideration, not a tested climbing score. Build gradual approach and exit sections at home and leave a way to reverse out. Axial's current table says the vehicle is not water resistant, so choose dry practice conditions rather than treating a trail photograph as waterproof permission.

The SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2 tire package is Nitto Trail Grappler M/T on KMC Machete wheels. Its intended terrain listing is indoor and off-road. Begin on a surface that lets you observe a consistent response, then adjust the course rather than immediately blaming the tire. Small stones, edges and loose fibers occupy a significant part of a micro vehicle’s obstacle scale. Remove debris and secure any homemade ramps or climbing pieces before the session. The published dimensions are 250 × 122 × 107 mm. They help plan the space and transport requirements, but they do not establish measured grip, rollover angle or jump behavior.

sections.heading: Scale accessories add interest and inspection points.
paragraphs: The Gladiator uses a detailed polycarbonate body with overland accessories, an interior treatment and bumper LEDs. Tim Gluth's original-version Small-Scale RC review discusses the body, accessory rack and longer format; we use that coverage only for historical scale context. The current V2 is the reviewed purchase. Check body attachment, light wiring and accessory screws after a tumble. Their visual appeal can justify choosing the pickup, but decorative items are not evidence of carrying capacity or a measured durability advantage.

The reviewed Green · Spektrum V2 complete crawler SCX24 Jeep JT Gladiator V2 is supplied as a complete vehicle with a finished body, rather than a replacement shell or bare platform. The official photographs show the exact package and relevant details; their staging is not our test record. Learn how the shell is secured before forcing access to the battery area, and protect any leads that cross between body and chassis. After running, inspect wheel attachment, steering movement and dirt accumulation, then consult the AXI00005V2T3 drawing for part identification. A correct replacement number can be more useful than an expensive upgrade when the original component simply needs servicing. Body material, metal gears or aluminum construction describe the hardware, but none is treated here as evidence of crash resistance or a long-term reliability rating without physical testing.

sections.heading: The $149.99 reference buys a coordinated micro package.
paragraphs: The official reference includes the drive pack, charger and transmitter cells, which keeps the first-session basket much shorter than a standard 1/10 RTR. Confirm the charging input and battery handling procedure rather than adding a generic new charger automatically. A correct small driver and a clean work area remain sensible ownership equipment. I would not order brass weights, new axles and a servo before learning the stock truck. Those changes should solve a recorded obstacle or steering problem, not simply recreate somebody else's modified build.

sections.heading: Buy the V2 because you want this long scale truck.
paragraphs: The documented package is well matched to a first micro scale-crawling buyer who prefers a Jeep pickup. The longer wheelbase and finished presentation are the strongest reasons to choose it; the included power and current oil shocks support that choice. The reservations are exact-generation identification, small-part compatibility and the dry-use requirement. I would keep the factory hardware initially, map the course to the wheelbase and consult V2 instructions before any upgrade. Historical praise for another radio package does not replace that work.
